properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 in reflow2-core's reasoning, report and detect modules (PR #763). On a design holding Inferences, loop_status carries `reasoning` (counts, and ids up to 20 each), said in `next` and never counted against `clean`; detect_gaps raises one aggregate low-severity `unconfirmed_reasoning` gap. `taken_as_given: true` (add_constraint, add_requirement) marks a stated foundation: not an uncited premise, listed in reasoning_report's stated_foundations; a Requirement taken as given holds. A design with no Inference reads byte for byte as before. Not built: dropping the Constraint `direction` default on a taken-as-given axiom.
properties.name: loop_status and detect_gaps count a reasoning's unconfirmed steps, uncited premises and claims shown but not proven, and a definition or axiom can be taken as given
